Requires privileged mount/nsenter operations on attacker-controlled filesystem or namespace state. Runway runs as UID 1000, has no mount/nsenter input path or CAP_SYS_ADMIN requirement, and removes inherited setuid/setgid permissions. Privileged containers and host Docker socket mounts are outside this exception. Re-reviewed 2026-10-23 for the Debian 13 (trixie) base: util-linux ships 2.41.5-0+deb13u1, and Debian 13 folded the separate login source package and the lastlog library into util-linux, so the family in this image is bsdutils, libblkid1, liblastlog2-2, libmount1, libsmartcols1, libuuid1, login, mount and util-linux. The server still invokes no mount or libmount operation and still runs as UID 1000 with setuid/setgid permissions stripped, and the runtime still has no privileged container, added capability, host Docker socket or custom user-mount fstab entry.
